title: VY Hub
features:
VY Hub Sword Factory Script

Sword Scanner

Custom God-Roll Sniper: Configure up to 5 profiles for specific 3-enchant combinations
Auto Teleport: Instantly teleports to matched swords, secures them, and returns to Sell Station
Creator ID Tracker: Scan swords crafted by specific players or across the server
Meta Presets: One-click presets for optimal god-roll builds
Smart Alerts: Visual highlights and sound alerts when a match appears
Auto Lock System: Automatically locks valuable enchants to prevent selling
NPC ESP & Scanners

NPC ESP & Scanners

Global Area Radar: Tracks high-rarity mobs across all zones
Spawn Alerts: On-screen alerts with sound notifications for rare spawns
Local NPC ESP: Displays nearby mobs showing names
Spawn Predictor

Spawn Predictor

Spawn Predictor: Calculates timing for Triple and Quad God spawns
Live Timer: Real-time countdown displayed on screen
Pre-Spawn Alerts: Audio warning before high-value spawns
Server Hop: Switch servers if spawn conditions are poor
Mob Farm

Mob Farm

Auto Farm: Fully automated mob farming system
Area Selection: Supports all zones from Mystical Forest to Ancient Mineshaft
Player Detection Safety: Returns to base if players are nearby, then resumes farming
Detection Radius Slider: Customize player detection range
Safe Farm System: Retreats when health drops below a set value
Auto Resume: Continues farming after safety delay
Auto Sell System: Sells loot while protecting valuable enchants
Enchant Scanner Compatibility: Fully AFK with scanner systems running
Death Loot Recovery: Recovers dropped items after death
Archer Auto-Dodge: Avoids archer attacks automatically
Combat Settings: Target priority, positioning, and distance control
Players Settings

Players Settings

Auto Evade: Returns to base if players enter your radius
Safe Zone Visualizer: Displays your protection radius
Global Player Tracker: Detects players in PvP zones
Player Loadout ESP: Shows weapons, class, and rarity
Health & Distance Tracking: Displays HP and distance in real time
Player Kill Aura

Player Kill Aura

Auto Kill Aura: Teleports to players within selected areas automatically
God Mode: Player is completely unkillable
Continuous Damage: Keeps targets in combat until they are eliminated
Auto Loot: Automatically collects dropped items after kills
Loot Delay: Waits before looting to reduce detection risk
Auto Ascender

Auto Ascender

Multi-Sword Queue: Process up to 4 swords automatically
Auto Upgrade System: Rolls swords until target stats are reached
Stat Targets: Set minimum values for Rarity, Quality, Mold, Class, and Level (up to 700)
Enchant Targeting: Configure up to 3 enchant level requirements
Custom Processing Order: Choose upgrade sequence or skip unwanted stats
Safety System: Pauses and returns to base if you leave the ascender area
Settings & Config

Settings & Config

Customizable UI: Fully customizable interface (themes, fonts, colors, size)
Auto-Save Configs: Saves all settings, profiles with auto-load options
Performance Optimization: Designed to maintain high FPS
Cross Platform: Works on both mobile and PC
Keybind Support: Toggle menu visibility with Right-Control
